title: .LLab Knowledge Transfer Checklist™
intro: Institutional memory that lives in one person's head isn't preserved — it's a single point of failure. This checks what would survive without you.

upsell.name: The .LLab Leadership Infrastructure Diagnostic™
upsell.copy: assesses all of The IV Phases™ at once, including this one.

nodes.prompt: My key decisions and their reasoning are written down somewhere.
At least one other person could explain my priorities in my absence.
Critical relationships aren't dependent on me personally to continue.
Important documents and systems are accessible to more than just me.
I've identified who would need to be brought up to speed, and how.
Institutional memory doesn't live only in informal conversations.
There's a plan for what happens to unfinished work if I step away.
I've reviewed this list in the last twelve months, not just once.

bands.label: 0–3 Checked
bands.copy: Very little is transferable right now. Start by writing down the reasoning behind one recent decision.

bands.label: 4–6 Checked
bands.copy: Some knowledge is captured. Pick the weakest checkbox and document it this month.

bands.label: 7–8 Checked
bands.copy: Knowledge transfer is strong. The Diagnostic™ below checks the other three phases too.

closing.prompt: The one piece of knowledge I'll get out of my head and into writing this month is:
